title: Paul in Thessalonica
description: Paul and Silas arrive in Thessalonica, where Paul preaches in the synagogue for three Sabbaths that Jesus is the Messiah. Some Jews, many god-fearing Greeks, and prominent women come to faith, but jealous Jews gather a mob, storm Jason's house, and drag him before the city officials with accusations of acting against the emperor. Jason and the others are released on bail.
